trends.insight: Diwali shoppers seek gourmet bakery hampers over mithai.
trends.move: Position our 12-pack cookie box as a non-traditional Diwali gift hamper.
trends.name: Diwali Artisanal Gift Hampers
trends.risk: Traditional sweet brands capture gifting share.
trends.what: LocalCircles survey of 200,000 consumers across 130 districts shows rising demand for curated bakery items.
trends.why_us: Our 12-pack box fits luxury festive gifting.

trends.insight: Halloween sticker shock drives shoppers to premium local treats.
trends.move: Launch a spooky-themed 4-pack box for final Halloween weekend treat runs.
trends.name: Halloween Bakery Treat Rush
trends.risk: Shoppers default to cheap mass candy.
trends.what: Scripps News survey finds 67% of consumers feel Halloween has become too expensive.
trends.why_us: Our local shop offers high-value indulgence.

trends.insight: Fall comfort dessert searches peak around apple orchard treats.
trends.move: Drop an apple cider caramel cookie flavor on the menu this weekend.
trends.name: Orchard Fruit Fall Comfort
trends.risk: Failing to capture seasonal flavor demand.
trends.what: Bon Appétit features 43 distinct apple desserts dominating search traffic this week.
trends.why_us: We bake fresh small-batch seasonal cookies.

trends.insight: Crumbl store closures signal vulnerability for mass-scale cookie chains.
trends.move: Emphasize our small-batch Brooklyn roots and honest ingredients in social content.
trends.name: Fast-Bake Value Fatigue
trends.risk: Consumers lump all cookie brands together.
trends.what: Crumbl CEO admits fault as sales drop 70% and dozens of locations close nationwide.
trends.why_us: Our small-batch model avoids industrial overexpansion.

trends.insight: Grocery brands launch holiday cookies early to capture seasonal spend.
trends.move: Highlight our own seasonal box lineup early for holiday shoppers.
trends.name: Grocery Cookie Seasonal Rollout
trends.risk: Grocery brands own early holiday mindshare.
trends.what: Tate's Bake Shop launches new Drizzled Shortbread and holiday grocery cookies.
trends.why_us: Fresh bakery quality beats grocery boxes.

trends.insight: Holiday gift guides feature early Hanukkah items alongside winter collections.
trends.move: Feature holiday boxes as ideal early Hanukkah gifts.
trends.name: Early Hanukkah Gifting Spotlights
trends.risk: Missing early gifting window for December holidays.
trends.what: Disney and retailers reveal Hanukkah collections ahead of the December holiday.
trends.why_us: Our boxes make ideal Hanukkah hostess gifts.

trends.insight: Iconic city bakeries expand regionally to capture national demand.
trends.move: Emulate their regional expansion storytelling on social.
trends.name: Craft Bakery Geographic Expansion
trends.what: Levain Bakery brings its famous cookies to Northern California for the first time.
trends.why_us: Independent craft status builds local loyalty.

trends.insight: Celebrity costume reveals dominate entertainment feeds.
trends.move: Ignore celebrity costume chatter and focus on shop traffic.
trends.name: Celebrity Halloween Costume Circus
trends.what: Google Frightgeist and media outlets publish top Halloween costume trends.
trends.why_us: Not connected to our baked goods.

trends.insight: Mass fast-food chains use sports wins for coupon giveaways.
trends.move: Focus on premium product quality over discount giveaways.
trends.name: Free Food Sports Promos
trends.risk: Training customers to wait for freebies.
trends.what: Krispy Kreme gives away free dozen doughnuts for Halloween weekend promotions.
trends.why_us: We never discount or devalue our cookies.
